p: fear the LORD thy God: A reverent face and love for God is the first beginning to keeping God's commandments.
in the land that floweth with: Which has an abundance of all things needed for man's life.
teach them diligently to thy children: Some read, "You shall whet them upon your children": that is, that they may imprint them more deeply in their memory.
posts of thy house: That when you enter in you may remember them.
Then beware lest thou shouldest forget: Do not let wealth and ease cause you to forget God's mercies, by which you were delivered out of misery.
swear by his name: We must fear God, serve him only and confess his Name, which is done by swearing lawfully.
tempt the LORD your God: By doubting his power, refusing lawful means, and abusing his graces.
sight of the LORD: Here he condemns all of man's good intentions.
thy son shall ask thee in: God not only requires that we serve him all our lives, but also that we see that our posterity sets forth his glory.
brought us out from thence: Nothing should move us more to true obedience than the great benefits which we have received from God.
righteousness: Because no one can fully obey the law, we must turn to Christ to be justified by faith.
